translation.name: Habo nalolene bi gahenge lo winigo ogo

book.name: LUGU
book.title: Lugu Luguhanda Bi Mana Debene gili binigo ogo

content: Bi yobage lowa wali dalo godi lagane agalila biyago te lenego ogo
Ani lowa Yasuhanda ibunaga talima piaga biarume, Wahalu poro, nale Ngode Datagaliwabehondo bi laabo halu helo ti lawai halu bi yobage ogo lamini.
Ibugua lalu, Dindi mbiraha godi lagane agali mbira henego ibugua Ngode Datagaliwabehondo gi nahagabi agali hearu hondowa dara nahagabi hene.

Ani buwa dindi ogoniha dege wali dalo mbira berenegome godi lagane agali biago hearia puabo howa lalu, I̱nagaore bayuwa mo tiga bia halu i̱la hoba mu kagonaga i̱ biamogo bia habe, lalu la debodebo biaabo haga berene.

Ani laabo halu berea tambu godi lagane agali biagome hale halu mbira bia nabiagaore henego mani howa ibuni hangu lo manda bialu lalu, Ngode Datagaliwabehondo i̱ gi nahe wali agalihondobi dara nahaga kogo

wali dalo o bedagome horo bibahendengi lawanana biaabo halu i̱ mo lulu ya harago i̱na tiga handalu wali ogoninaga genda yu bedagoni mo tiga bulebero. Ani nabiruyagua wali ogonime i̱ koria iba ho wiaabo halu i̱ mo genda holebira, laya, lene.
Anduane Homogohanda laabo halu lalu, Godi lagane agali tigabi ndo ogonime biamogo bialu howa o layadagoni hale halu manda bilimu.

Anigo Ngode Datagaliwabehanda tigatiga hanuniore dabagane kagome ibunaga wali agalime horombe mbiragabi ibuhondo, Biamogo bia, laabo halu haragola biamogo nabulebirabe. Ibugua tendoreore biamogo bulebirabe.
I̱na tí langerogo ibugua hanuniore howa dabalu abaleore ti biamogo bulebira. Anigo Agali Hole Ibiyagome dindini lone ibuwa wali agali mini mbiraore wu karia handa hondolebirabe, lene.
Bi yobage lowa Perisi agalibi dagisi muni miaga agalibi biyago te lenego ogo
Yasuhanda bi yobage lowa wali agali maru hearume tini bayale tigabi hangu biaga kama lalu wali agali maru karu ko biaga ka laga hearuhondo lalu,
Agali kira mendego Perisi agali mendego dagisi muni miaga agali libugua Anduane Homogonaga andaha Ngode Datagaliwabehondo bi lole pene.

Perisi agali biagome ibuni hanguore howa Ngode Datagaliwabehondo bi lalu, I̱ ko nabiaga mbirale kayubi wali kayubi nabiaga marume ko biagadagua nabiruligonaga Ngode Datagaliwabe í̠hondo turu halu ka̱i̱ laro. Dagisi muni miaga na̱i̱ kagome biagadagua i̱na nabiruligo í̠hondo ka̱i̱ laro.
I̱na Sarere mbiranaga horo kiru tomo nane haruli horo bibahendengi yolo merogo mialu pinigo í̠naga lowa wiruli, lalu Ngode Datagaliwabehondo bi lene.

Ibu ani lalu hea tambu dagisi muni miaga biagome amuraore howa Ngode Datagaliwabehondo bi lalu hearia hariha handa daga nahe ibuni galu kunini balu lalu, I̱ koorene kogo Ngode Datagaliwabe í̠na i̱hondo dara habe, laya, lene.

Yasuhanda lalu, I̱na tí langerogo libu andaga dai buwa Ngode Datagaliwabela mo mbiraore ho henego Perisi agali biago ndo dagisi muni miaga biago ibu hene. Ogoninaga mbiralime ibuni mo yaraga hayagua ibu mo dindiha helalu mbiralime ibuni mo dindiha hayagua ibu mo yaraga ho helolebira, lene.
Yasuhanda waneigini emene mo turu henego ogo

Wali agali maru hearume Yasuhanda ti waneigini emene haguaneni gi wialu mo turu helo lowa taba yalu ibu hearia íbu ngoai hene. Ani biyagola ibunaga talima piaga biarume hondowa o biyagoni nabilo ti talini.
Ani biyago hondowa Yasuhanda, Waneigini i̱ kogoria ibidaba, lowa, Waneigini i̱ kogoria ibiragola naibilo ha pai nahalimu. Irane Ngode Datagaliwabehanda Handame Ho Kagoria waneigini urubi karunaga ka.
Tíhondo larogo manda bilimu. Waneiginime Ngode Datagaliwabehanda Handame Ho Kagoria hoa hagadagua hoa nahe karume nde anda napolebira, lene.
Agali homogo mbira henego ogo
Yu wali agali hondo haga mbirame Yasuhondo lalu, Lawai haga bayale-o i̱na haabobo holene mo yule agi buabe, lene.
Ani layagola Yasuhanda ibuhondo ladai bialu lalu, Í̠na i̱ bayale larigo irane agibe. Mbirali bayale nahe Ngode Datagaliwabe ibuni hangu bayale ka.
Bi mana lowini ngago í̠na manda bu kegoni. Wali agali kayu nabibe. Wali agali homelo nababe. Mbirale page nabibe. Ke̱ howa dibade nahabe. Aba ai̱yala mo yo handa nabi laradagua hale halu bibe, lene.
Ani layagola agali biagome ladai bialu lalu, Bi o lariruni bibahende lo ngago i̱na igiri emeneoreni howa biai harugoni, lene.

Ani ladai biyagola hale howa Yasuhanda agali biagohondo lalu, Í̠na mbiraore hangu bibehe kego í̠naga mbirale wiruni bibahende yolo miai hole pu. Ani buwa muni ngirago yagibano karu mo meregola dahuliya andagani homogo holene í̠naga wulebira. Ani buwa i̱ porodagua talima ibabe, lene.
Bi ani layago hale howa agali biagome ibu homogo gibi henego dara halu tingini biagoni bibahende pirila paya bini.
Yasuhanda agali biago darabi howa tingini pirila paya bu heago hondowa lalu, Homogo karume Ngode Datagaliwabehanda Handame Ho Kagoria anda polene erekuibiore wulebira.
Nogo kameleme háli diriha anda polene erekuibi lowa homogo karume Ngode Datagaliwabehanda Handame Ho Kagoria anda polene erekuiore wulebira, lene.
Wali agali bu hearume Yasuhanda bi layago hale howa ibuhondo lalu, Ai imame pele mulene yu holebirabe, lene.
Ani layagola Yasuhanda ladai bialu lalu, Wali agalime bibe naheore ngago Ngode Datagaliwabehanda biai habeheore kagoni, lene.
Ani layagola Pidahanda lalu, Ai handa, Inanaga dindi andabi wahalu í̠ talima ibirimagoni, lene.

Ani layagola Yasuhanda tihondo lalu, E̱ anigo i̱na tíhondo heneneore larogo mbiralime dindi andabi onebi hamenebi aba ai̱yabi waneiginibi helai halu Ngode Datagaliwabehanda Handame Ho Kagoria hangu handaya ho yalu poragola
áyu dindini ka tambu timbuniore yu howa mani haabobo holene ngago yu holebira, lene.
Yasuhanda ibuni homolenenaga te halu tebone lenego ogo

Yasuhanda ibunaga talima piaga homberiali (12) biaru haru pu bagi howa tihondo lalu, Hale hadaba. Ina Yarusaleme pole poramagoni. Puwa mbirale bibahende Ngode Datagaliwabe mana latagi haga henerume Agali Hole Ibiyagonaga mbiwia halu gilibu wini ngago lola hai holebira.
Mbiralime Agali Hole Ibiyago Yu agali ndo agali tara karuhondo minu miragola tigua ibuhondo mege bialubi bi ko lalubi hamiaga tolo ba halubi bulebira.
Tigua ibu pu payini tibume balu tongolo milolebira. Ani biragola horo kiru howa tebonengi ibuni mo heya holebira, lalu lamini.

Ibunaga talima piaga biarume o layagoni irane ogo alenaga laya lalu manda nabiore hene. Ti ogoninaga bi galone manda nabilo mo do hene. Ani biyagola tigua Yasuhanda layagoni ogo ale layalo manda nabiore hene.
Yasuhanda agali de kohe mo dengala henego ogo
Yasu ibu Yarigo anda ibule biyagola agali mbira de kohego hariga leneha biruwa munibi mbiralebi, Ngidaba, laabo haga berene.
Ibugua wali agali dewa bi lama piayuago hale howa lalu, O laruago agidabe, lene.
Tigua ibu lamialu lalu, Nasareteali Yasu o bolangua halu poragoni, lene.
Ani layagola ibugua abale olowa lalu, Debidi Igini Yasu-o i̱ dara howa biamogo bia, lene.

Ani olayagola Yasu maha helalu wali agali bamba halu piyarume agali biago talialu lalu, Bi nale waha, lene. Ani layagola ibu donge howa dalimuore olalu, Debidi Igini-o i̱ dara howa biamogo bia, lalu laabo hene.

Ani olayagola hale howa Yasuhanda ema nabi hondo howa lalu, Agali de kohe amu bedago i̱ koria haru ibidaba, lene. Ani layagola tigua ibu haru halu howa de kohe biago Yasu heagoria ha para hayagola Yasuhanda lalu,
I̱na í̠hondo agi buliya hamelo kebe, lene. Ibugua ladai bialu lalu, Anduane-o i̱ lone de hondoa ko, lene.
Yasuhanda ibuhondo lalu, De handa. Í̠ni Ngode Datagaliwabehondo mini mbiraore wirigome í̠naga de mo ngala hayagoni, lene.

Ani layaore de kohe biago ibunaga de abaleore dabi halu de handabehe hayagola ibugua Ngode Datagaliwabehondo turu halu ka̱i̱ lalu Yasu piyadagua pene. Wali agali bu hearume o biyago hondowa ti bibahendeme Ngode Datagaliwabenaga mini yaraga halu hene.
